system.description:
See Figurine of Wondrous Power

This serpentine statuette of an owl can become a Giant Owl for up to 8 hours. The owl can communicate telepathically with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.

notes: not automated (summon): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
summon: its creature is not among the converted creatures
